steps.speaker: Answer Machine
steps.content: Hi there. I'm currently unable to answer the phone. Please leave a message after the tone.
Beep...
Ahh... Hi there.
I'm starting to miss you. Will you come to me? I want to hear your voice.
...Okay, then. I'll see you tonight.
In the night, the stationary object screams in inaudible vibrations.
This continues until the notification light on the phone goes out, and everything returns to silence.
You look at the comms device in your hand. The bright red "low battery" icon flashes for a few seconds before the screen completely falls into black.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who's been using my comms to make random calls again...? It can't really be a ghost, can it...
Recently, an urban legend wave about "Ghost Calls" is sweeping across Eastside, reaching even the Bureau. Day or night, every corner of the Bureau is filled with startling phone rings and busy tones.
Whispers buzz around your ears. Sometimes, you really feel like someone is whispering secrets into your ear and trying to lure you into an abyss.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When I get back, I will find the instigator... and then... give them a good...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sigh... Can't I take a break without any trouble?
You sigh and put away the comms device.

Originally, you were going to enjoy a rare day off after attending the "Forum on Strengthening the Management and Efficiency of Hypercubes in the Response to Mania Crisis Incidents" with the Public Security Bureau in Eastside.

But now your comms device is completely out of power, and you can't contact the hotel you booked. You plan to go to the grocery store next door and get some coins to call your adjutant for help from a phone booth.

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "Hello, welcome to Call at 3 AM. I'm your host... Eleven."

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "I'm glad to share some thoughts with you all about recent events..."

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: Woah, she's certainly keeping her cool in this crisis. Still hosting the show as if nothing happened...

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: Oh, excuse me. I was too distracted listening to the program. Sorry, I didn't see you there.
The owner, who was sitting casually behind the counter, quickly stands up straight when he sees you.

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: Still out so late, young man? What would you like?
steps.female_content: Still out so late, young lady? What would you like?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A bottle of water, please. Can you give me some change in cash?

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: Let me see, I might only have some coins left... I'm not sure if it's enough...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's okay. I'll take a few of these, too.
You pick out a few brightly wrapped candies from the glass bowl on the counter and put them in your pocket along with the coins.

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "Next, we'll open up the phone lines, and invite everyone to call in..."

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: Well, let's see how many "Ghost Calls" we get tonight...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ghost Calls?
You take the water from the owner's hand and glance at the small radio on the other side of the counter.

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: You haven't heard about this?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've only heard a little about it.

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: This show, Call at 3 AM...

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: It ain't clean!

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: They say this host has the same voice as the legendary female ghost who will call you at 3 a.m. and claim your life through the phone! After this went viral, her show's phone lines have blown up!

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: At first, everyone thought it was just a publicity stunt by the radio station, but...
The grocery store owner beckons you to lean closer.

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: Since then, several people who had called the radio station disappeared!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Disappeared? They went missing? Or...

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: If they went missing, they would at least leave some traces, right? These people... simply evaporated from the face of the earth! See?
The grocery store owner nods towards the shop's door. You see several posters on it, all of them missing person notices.

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: But... I reckon those people might not necessarily have anything to do with this radio station.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <size=30>I think so, too. How could a radio station have such power? It feels like just a silly rumor...</size>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Cough cough. What's your take on this?

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: Well look, she works at a radio station. She's a popular radio host. With popularity comes controversy. It's probably just a silly rumor.

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: We're just looking for something to keep us entertained. Look at me, keeping the shop open so late into the night. It's so tedious. It's nice to listen to some idiot messing around on the radio to pass the time.

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: Those who vanished, most of them are idle people who threw money around all day and night on radio shows and hosts. It's not surprising that they attracted attention.

steps.speaker: Grocery Store Owner
steps.content: Rumor has it that these people all received a call before they disappeared. But the Public Security Bureau insists there are no records of these calls.
You walk out of the grocery store, and the owner behind you turns up the volume of the radio a bit more.
The voice of the host echoes faintly, causing a tingling sensation on your back.

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "Thank you for your call. Thank you for sharing your experiences and insights with us."

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "People often feel anxious, becoming frustrated and wanting to vent."

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "You are welcome to call us at any time."
After leaving the grocery store, you walk down the street. There should be a phone booth around here.
It looks a bit old, but because it's transparent and covered with graffiti, it doesn't seem so dreary.
You think about the story the store owner mentioned earlier, and start to wonder if there might be Mania powers at work.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I'm on vacation. I shouldn't think about work.
As you try to dispel the thoughts of work in your mind, you're jolted by a sudden ring of the phone.
You jump in surprise. When you look up, you realize that you're trapped inside the small phone booth!
The small space is filled with echoing rings and deathly silence. The public telephone appears before you, like a phone book abandoned by the world.

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "Let's look forward to the next call~"
The voice isn't loud, but to you, it's like a thunderclap.
You're already a distance away from the grocery store, and the booth's door is tightly shut. There's no way you should still be able to hear the radio station from here.
Ting-a-ling... ting-a-ling...

steps.speaker: Radio Voice
steps.content: "Pick it up~ Don't be scared, it's not a big deal~"
The old public phone suddenly rings. Your mind flashes back to those strange calls at the Bureau.
The ones known as "Ghost Calls."
Your first reaction is to leave the phone booth, but it's as if someone is holding the door shut from outside. You can't make it budge at all.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Damn it!
You grit your teeth. A faint red light emanates from your palm as you prepare to use the power of the shackles.

options: Pick up and hang up immediately

steps.content: You don't want to answer the phone and stare at it as it continues to ring, letting the shrill sound echo inside the phone booth.
But the ringing shows no sign of abating. Your ears are starting to hurt, and your consciousness is gradually becoming blurred.
At this moment, a soft laugh echoes in your ear.
Aren't you going to answer?
Cold sweat breaks out on the back of your neck. You grit your teeth and reach out to pick up the phone.
The piercing ring grows louder. You can't bear it any longer.
Gritting your teeth, you reach out and pick up the phone.
Amidst the piercing ringing, you pick up the receiver without hesitation and immediately hang up.
The echo of the phone ringing still reverberates in the small booth. You can sense the vibrations and hear your own racing heartbeat.
Hehe... So naughty...
A strange female voice suddenly rings out from behind you, causing cold sweat to break out on the back of your neck.
You have to answer~
The relentless ringing starts again, growing louder, making your eardrums and heart tremble.
You grit your teeth and reach out to pick up the phone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hello...
You finally decided to answer my call?
Hearing your voice... makes me happy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who are you? Do you know me? And why are you... calling me?
You look at the public phone, really wanting to hang up.
Don't hang up, darling... I'm here to help you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Help me? If you want to help me, let me call my adjutant or the MBCC instead of hogging the line.
You should talk more, I like your voice...
Take good care of it... Take good care of yourself...
Let this voice echo in your mind... in your heart... in the whole wide world...
Beep... Beep... Beep...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hello?! Hello...?!
The call is terminated, and a dial tone emits from the receiver. You're still in shock, and your ears are still ringing.
You hang up the phone, remaining in the phone booth to calm down for a while. After observing your surroundings and finding nothing strange, you slowly retract your shackles.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Was it a prank...?
The door of the phone booth clicks and unlocks.
You quickly push the door open, intending to rush back to the Bureau to find out who's playing tricks on you. But as you step out, you realize something is wrong.
A strong sense of discomfort hits you head-on. The streetlights cast a strange purple glow. The occasional flickering signal fault distorts the buildings and lights before returning to normal.
But for you, what's even more disturbing is the strong Mania enveloping the area.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This place... is a world constructed entirely by Mania!!
